© 2026 EV — personal memory companion

EV listens continuously through your microphone for the wake word "EVIE", and records what you say next when it hears it or when you press ⇧⌘E. Audio is used for wake detection, speaker verification, and your request, and is sent only to the EV backend you configure (127.0.0.1 by default).
EV turns the audio that follows the wake word "EVIE" into text so it can answer you. Recognition runs against the EV backend you configure (127.0.0.1 by default).
EV uses the camera only when you explicitly capture a photo or video note.
EV uses screen content only when you enable ambient context collectors, and never sends raw pixels to any model.
EV sends Apple events only when an action you asked for has to drive another app, such as opening a note or a calendar entry.
EV looks up people in Contacts only when you ask it to remember, find, or message someone.
EV reads and creates calendar events only when you ask it to check or add something to your schedule.
